title: Antimicrobial Action, Susceptibility and Resistance Fundamentals
method: Whitespace-delimited actual visible teaching paragraphs only, excluding headings, tables, SVG, figure captions, citations, questions, references and reader UI. Article count includes visible headings, captions, tables, question explanations and references but excludes SVG, section citation markers and zoom buttons. Eight worked examples: net-rate model, relative suppression versus viable loss, MIC endpoint, MIC fold difference, censored MIC bound, and three viable-loss/log-reduction examples.
comparator: Same-subunit published QA records: 2.E.05 14952, 2.E.07 14943, 2.E.10 14253 narrative words. Node 2.E.09 treats 15 substantial theory sections, from target selectivity and evidence through all five action categories, endpoint mathematics and limitations, intrinsic/acquired resistance, tolerance/persistence and integrated reasoning. Detailed molecular resistance spread belongs to 2.E.10.
scientific_checks: Verified merged CSIR-DBT NET Unit 2.E page 3, separate CSIR Life Sciences page 2 and archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually. Sources include Fleming 1929, Tipper/Strominger 1965, Yocum et al. 1980, OpenStax, quinolone and ribosomal reviews, Balaban et al. 2004 and 2019, EUCAST. Two editorial self-review passes added spectrum, biochemical and persistence evidence, clarified tolerance and comparative interpretation, expanded log reduction comparisons, corrected folate and ribosome diagrams and dark contrast. Recomputed net rates 0.3/0, ratio 4, 99.8% and log10(500)=2.69897, 99.99% and four logs, fractions 0.1/0.001 and 9.9 percentage points; practice net rates 0.2/0.2, ratio 8, fraction 0.002 and 2.69897 logs, three logs. All illustrative data and questions original; no real experimental susceptibility protocols or clinical treatment advice.
limitations: Two substantive editorial self-review passes, not an independent human expert review. Static source, label and diagram geometry checks only; interactive browser/device/accessibility audit not performed. MP SET comparator is an archived copy, not an original current MPPSC-hosted PDF; AMR is explicitly in the merged NET syllabus rather than the older 2.E SET line. GitHub Pages deployment verification separate and pending.
